title: Oven Roasted Italian Rice Trofie
description: A low-carb Italian dish featuring rice, pickle, and trofie, perfect for a post-workout meal. This recipe is made in a Dutch oven and roasted to perfection in the oven.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the cauliflower rice and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the trofie pasta, pickle relish, cherry tomatoes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and stir in the grated parmesan cheese.
Return the Dutch oven to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and stir in the chopped fresh basil.
Serve the oven roasted Italian rice trofie hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
